response.sql: SELECT AVG(Total) AS average_total FROM Invoice WHERE Total IS NOT NULL AND Total > 3.98;

assumptions.assumption: "More than 3.98" is a strict comparison (Total > 3.98), so an invoice totaling exactly 3.98 is excluded.
The average is taken over invoice rows, one per invoice, using Invoice.Total, not over invoice lines.
AVG returns NULL when no rows qualify, which gives the requested missing result. The value is not rounded.
